referenceSources.title: Alfa Romeo 75 Turbo Evoluzione Guide — Supercar Nostalgia
referenceSources.description:
The Alfa Romeo 75 Turbo Evoluzione, produced in 1987 as a Group A homologation special, is presented here in its signature Rosso Alfa finish. Built to meet the FIA’s requirement of 500 evolution models, it features widened wheel arches, deep side skirts, and a prominent rear spoiler imported from the V6 variant. The matching Rosso Alfa wheels and enlarged cooling intakes underscore its racing intent.

Under the hood, the Evoluzione’s 1.75‑litre turbocharged inline-four engine was de‑bored to 1752 cc to qualify for Class 2, delivering around 175 bhp. A transaxle layout with a five-speed gearbox and limited-slip differential provided balanced handling, while stiffer springs, thicker anti-roll bars, and vented disc brakes improved track performance. This homologation special formed the basis of Alfa Romeo’s 1987 World Touring Car Championship campaign.
